name: Forearm Plank

instructions.description: Lie face down and place your forearms on the floor with elbows under shoulders.
Tuck your toes, lift your body, and form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abdomen and squeeze your glutes while breathing steadily.
Lower your knees or body to the floor in a controlled way when the hold ends.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold only as long as alignment can be maintained.

variations.variationDescription: Both challenge trunk stability, but the plank uses an isometric anti-extension hold.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform from the knees to reduce lever length.
Add alternating taps to increase anti-rotation demand.

commentsNotes: Avoid letting the hips sag or pike up.
Keep the head in line with the spine.
